Human Metapneumovirus is a respiratory virus similar to RSV and the flu, which can affect anyone but poses a higher risk to children, older adults, and those with weakened immune systems.

Stay informed and consult your healthcare professional for guidance during this time. https://t.co/3YVuKE6B3p
